check:pose-allocations: 2000 warm-up frames of the 1024-player threaded tick, about 21 ms each. With 300 or 700 warm-up frames the sampler still sees one-off function-level allocations (10128 B and 1224 B) from V8 tier-up, so the warm-up cannot be shortened without a false failure.
check:engine-state-hash-1024: Five isolated 1024-tier runs of 120 ticks (fixed, and 2, 4, 7, 8 workers). They now run at the same time; before, they ran one after another and the 4-worker run was done twice (29 s).
check:gc-witness: 20000 measured ticks and 20000 control ticks under a GC observer. The count is the claim, so the ticks stay.
check:elevation-ab: Runs spoint A/B elevation script at the fixture N and compares its output line for line.
check:scenario-marble-bowl: 512 bodies for 600 ticks, twice, on two tiers.
check:height-cpu: Evaluates every spoint height fixture sample to 1e-12.
check:heightmap-cli: Runs the heightmap CLI once per fixture case.
check:sphere-population: Places the full sphere population and checks every member.
check:engine-threads: Runs the threaded scenario at several worker counts.
check:mapspinner-atmosphere: Integrates the atmosphere tables against spoint values.
check:snapshots: Encodes and decodes the delta history at full depth.
check:thread-sampler: Samples real threads over a timed window.
build:kernel: Compiles the kernel with jz. It is skipped when src/kernel and the jz package are unchanged.
